propositions: compact.py at 798 LOC exceeds the 800-line cap and bundles three separate responsibilities (transaction, snapshot reconstruction, CLI) with unacceptable cyclomatic complexity
Circular import hazard prevents splitting shared snapshot primitives across transaction and rebuild engines; all four must co-locate in compact_txn.py to maintain acyclic dependency graph
Module-level global _REBUILD_COUNT must be defined in compact_rebuild.py where rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log does global _REBUILD_COUNT, not in compact.py, to avoid silent counter misreporting

Test monkeypatches on compact module object (_git and lock attributes) fail after split because extracted functions read their original module globals, requiring repointing patches to compact_txn._git and _lock
Public re-exports from compact.py preserve external consumer import paths across the split, requiring no edits to fsck_repair.py, fsck_restore.py, or existing test files beyond monkeypatch repointing
